extensionDescription.message: Opens mailto links in configurable GroupWise, SOGo and Roundcube instances.

optionsIntro.message: Select your webmail system and enter its address. The extension receives access only to this domain.

optionsPrivacyNotice.message: Recipients, subject and message body are processed locally and passed only to the configured webmail instance. There is no telemetry or disclosure to the developer. Read the privacy policy.

urlHint.message: Enter the normal login or webmail URL. Installation paths are preserved.

configSaved.message: Saved. Open webmail tabs have been reloaded.

dispatchInitial.message: The mailto link is being passed to the configured webmail client.

dispatchSetupRequired.message: First select your webmail system and save its address on the settings page that was opened.

dispatchDelivered.message: The new-message editor has been opened.

dispatchOpened.message: Webmail has been opened. After signing in, the message editor will appear automatically.

pendingLinks.message: $COUNT$ mailto link(s) are waiting to be passed on.

noInstanceConfigured.message: No webmail instance has been configured yet.

errorHttpsRequired.message: The webmail URL must use HTTPS.

errorNoCredentials.message: The URL must not contain credentials.

errorMailtoLength.message: The mailto link is empty or too long.

errorAccessDenied.message: Access to the webmail domain was not allowed.

errorSaveConfig.message: The configuration could not be saved.

errorHandlerNotCaptured.message: GroupWise was initialized before the extension. Reload the tab.

diagHandlerAccepted.message: The GroupWise handler accepted the link

diagFrameNoResponse.message: Frame found, but the GroupWise handler did not respond

diagActionAccepted.message: The GroupWise action service accepted the link

privacyProcessingText.message: Recipients, CC, BCC, subject and message body of a mailto: link are processed exclusively on the user's device. They are passed only to the webmail instance configured by the user.

privacyStorageText.message: The extension stores the configured webmail URL, selected system, links not yet handed off and technical diagnostic data locally. Pending links are discarded after no more than 24 hours.

privacyNoSharingText.message: There is no telemetry, advertising or analytics. Data is not transmitted to the developer or any other third party. Further processing by webmail is governed by its operator's policies.

privacyPermissionsText.message: storage is used for local storage. scripting registers the integration. Domain access is granted only after consent and only for the configured HTTPS domain.
